claims.text: Places Ranked by Women's FINANCIAL Inclusion
claims.support: A global ranking of women's financial inclusion across 142 countries and territories.
A global ranking of women's financial inclusion.

claims.text: A global ranking of women's financial inclusion, measuring access to bank and mobile money accounts across 142 countries and territories.
claims.support: Global Findex Database, 142 mapped countries and territories.

claims.text: France hits 99.8 percent for women with accounts. Yemen stops at 5.4 percent.
claims.support: France value is 99.848494933374 (display 99.8%), Yemen value is 5.43631354617772 (display 5.4%).

claims.text: Yemen is the lowest on Earth. Pakistan has 11.9 percent and Niger has 12.2 percent.
claims.support: Yemen rank is 142 (lowest), Pakistan value is 11.9121696598431 (display 11.9%), Niger value is 12.2030464030006 (display 12.2%).

claims.text: This counts women who use a mobile money service or have a bank account.
claims.support: Account definition: percentage of respondents who report having an account at a financial institution or report personally using a mobile money service (female, % age 15+).

claims.text: Nigeria has 52.2 percent and Indonesia has 58 percent.
claims.support: Nigeria value is 52.2155914465012 (display 52.2%), Indonesia value is 58.0308451514518 (display 58%).

claims.text: India and China both have 89.2 percent.
claims.support: India value is 89.2482328079147 (display 89.2%), China value is 89.2021200745424 (display 89.2%).

claims.text: USA has 97.1 percent. UK has 99.3 percent.
claims.support: United States value is 97.1092143262693 (display 97.1%), United Kingdom value is 99.2689870562959 (display 99.3%).

claims.text: France is the world's highest at 99.8 percent. It has 18 times the value Yemen has.
claims.support: France rank is 1, value 99.848%. Yemen value is 5.436%. 99.848 / 5.436 approx 18.36 times.

claims.text: What would change if every woman had a bank account?
claims.support: Outro card exploring hypothetical financial inclusion.
